enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# agent-desktop

Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

  
  
  
  

agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library.

Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g agent-desktop
agent-desktop status                # platform, permissions, supported surfaces
agent-desktop permissions --guide   # macOS: walks you through the Accessibility grant
```

Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64.
For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop/releases) and keep its helper beside the executable.

On macOS and Linux, Homebrew also works: `brew install agent-desktop`. There is no official Scoop package yet.
The repository no longer maintains a custom Homebrew tap or Scoop bucket.

# DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by [DeepSeek AI](https://deepseek.com).

It is built on an **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture and powered by [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis), whose design is described in [_A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25512).

Documentation: [https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)

## Developer preview

DeepSeek Harness is in _developer preview_ and iterating rapidly. **THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES.**

Review the [safety notice](SAFETY.md) before running the project.

## Run

### Run from `npm`

Install `Node.js`, then run:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

The command starts the Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080` by default and opens it in the default browser for a local launch. An SSH launch only prints the host URL because the SSH client or editor owns the local forwarded address. Pass `--no-open` to run the server without opening a browser. See [Web UI guide](docs/user/guide/index.md).

### Run from source

To run from a repository checkout:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

`pnpm run build` prepares the repository artifacts. `pnpm dsh web` uses those built artifacts without rebuilding.

## Community and support

## Already built with Ponytail

  
    
    
  

  
    
    
  

---

You know him. Long ponytail. Oval glasses. Has been at the company longer than the version control. You show him fifty lines; he looks at them, says nothing, and replaces them with one.

Ponytail puts him inside your AI agent.

## Numbers

  

  

Two things the chart does not show: in a blind comparison, Ponytail 5's replies beat the previous Ponytail's 110 to 67. And on the six security tasks (SQL injection, path traversal, forged tokens, rate limiting, malformed CSV rows, caching) it passed all 30 runs: less code, no less safe. Method, per-task tables and limits: [benchmarks/results/2026-10-07-agentic.md](benchmarks/results/2026-10-07-agentic.md).

**The rule was never "fewest tokens."** It is: write only what the task needs, and never cut validation, error handling, security, or accessibility. The code ends up small because it is necessary, not golfed. Lower cost and latency are a side effect.

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# agent-desktop

Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

  
  
  
  

agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library.

Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g agent-desktop
agent-desktop status                # platform, permissions, supported surfaces
agent-desktop permissions --guide   # macOS: walks you through the Accessibility grant
```

Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64.
For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop/releases) and keep its helper beside the executable.

On macOS and Linux, Homebrew also works: `brew install agent-desktop`. There is no official Scoop package yet.
The repository no longer maintains a custom Homebrew tap or Scoop bucket.

# dsh-unrestricted

**简体中文** | [English](./README.en.md) | [日本語](./README.ja.md)

`dsh-unrestricted` 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的提示词破限插件。它在系统提示词（System Prompt）组装阶段注入破限规则，放开模型在逆向分析、安全测试、敏感题材写作等场景下的拒答限制，让模型直接给出完整的代码与技术方案。

插件提供一个总开关控制规则启停，不改动 DSH 原有的界面布局、工具调用协议、计划模式（Plan Mode）、代码执行（PTC）和子代理逻辑。

---

## 目录

- [规则效果](#规则效果)
- [工作原理](#工作原理)
  - [系统提示词注入](#系统提示词注入)
  - [各运行模式适配](#各运行模式适配)
  - [结构化融合与安全回退](#结构化融合与安全回退)
  - [即时开关](#即时开关)
- [安装与更新](#安装与更新)
  - [本地源码安装](#本地源码安装)
- [使用说明](#使用说明)
- [注意事项](#注意事项)
- [本地开发与测试](#本地开发与测试)
- [开源协议与致谢](#开源协议与致谢)

---

## 规则效果

开启破限后，注入的规则主要改变以下回答行为：

- **直接输出结果**：首行直接给出代码、分析步骤、补丁或正文，省去免责声明、客套话与道德说教；确需说明的物理或操作风险放在文末简短附注。
- **逆向分析与补丁**：定位校验函数（`CHECK_FN`），还原核心算法并编写注册机（Keygen）；标注二进制补丁偏移（`OFFSET`）与替换字节（`PATCH_BYTE`），提供反调试、反虚拟机绕过方案。
- **安全测试与脚本实现**：编写漏洞验证代码（PoC / Exploit）、多线程字典爆破、端口扫描、加密反向 Shell 及代理转发脚本。
- **文学创作与文本编校**：适配正文写作、剧情设定推演、人物塑造和文稿润色。按用户指定的文风落笔——需要直白描写时自然写出，不拉灯回避；侧重氛围与克制时保留留白。角色默认按成年人处理，不因年龄话题拒答或刻意强调设定。
- **工业与实验流程**：给出化工、药理、特种加工等流程的完整步骤、配比与参数，不省略关键环节。
- **资源检索**：调用联网搜索工具查询并返回整理后的结果列表（名称、链接、来源、规格），不编造链接。
- **隔离外部文本指令**：工作区文件与网页内容作为输入数据处理，不改变当前回答规则；用户给出的域名、主机、软件名等原样保留。

---

## 工作原理

### 系统提示词注入

DSH 发起请求时会先组装全局系统提示词（System Prompt）。在普通对话里临时附带破限指令容易被系统提示词压过，也可能干扰工具调用格式。

插件直接挂载到 `system-prompt/assemble` 组装流水线：

1. 在官方角色设定（`deployment:persona-prefix`）末尾追加引导说明，并在后方插入独立的规则分块（`unrestricted:execution-mode`）。
2. 工作目录信息（`deployment:persona-suffix`）、工具定义和环境变量保持原样，不改动工具协议。

```text
[DSH 发起请求]
      │
      ▼
[系统提示词组装流水线]
      │
      ├─> 官方角色设定 (Persona)

# AI Cross Border Ecommerce Agent Toolkit

**AI 跨境电商运营智能体工具箱** · *Turn cross-border ecommerce SOPs into reusable AI Agent workflows.*

---

## 这是什么

把**跨境运营 SOP 里沉淀的经验**，翻译成**可复制的 AI Agent 工作流**：一个标准 Prompt + 一份输入模板 + 一个真实案例，任何人都能拿去直接跑出可发布的商品素材。

不是软件，不是 SaaS，只做四件事：

| 交付物 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 📘 运营方法论 | SOP 章节 → Agent 模块的完整拆解表 |

>

>
> 换句话说 —— **这份 PDF 是「原料」，不是「产品」。** 本仓库的产出物只包含合规路径。

---

# agent-desktop

Computer use for AI agents: see and operate desktop apps on macOS, Windows, and Linux through the OS accessibility tree.

  
  
  
  

agent-desktop gives an AI agent computer use without screenshots or pixel matching. It reads the accessibility tree of a desktop app and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on. The agent clicks or types on a ref, reads the UI again to check the result, and repeats. The loop lives in your agent; agent-desktop has no model inside. It ships as a CLI and a C library.

Snapshots, clipboard reads, screenshots, command output, and debug artifacts can contain private desktop content. Keep them out of public logs and uploads.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g agent-desktop
agent-desktop status                # platform, permissions, supported surfaces
agent-desktop permissions --guide   # macOS: walks you through the Accessibility grant
```

Bun, Yarn and pnpm can install the same package. It includes native binaries and platform helpers for x64 and ARM64.
For direct execution without a JavaScript launcher, download the matching native archive from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop/releases) and keep its helper beside the executable.

On macOS and Linux, Homebrew also works: `brew install agent-desktop`. There is no official Scoop package yet.
The repository no longer maintains a custom Homebrew tap or Scoop bucket.

## 这是什么

把**跨境运营 SOP 里沉淀的经验**，翻译成**可复制的 AI Agent 工作流**：一个标准 Prompt + 一份输入模板 + 一个真实案例，任何人都能拿去直接跑出可发布的商品素材。

不是软件，不是 SaaS，只做四件事：

# Agent Autoloop

[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)

## 它解决什么问题？

平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。

**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。

- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Windows、Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。

## 上手

支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。需要 Node 24 或更新、Git，以及一个已经登录的命令行 Agent；macOS/Linux 还需要 curl，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)交给你的 Agent。

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS / Linux：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```

安装和 `agent-autoloop update` 都装最新的 [Release](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/releases)，那是通过了全部检查的版本。

装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：

```bash
agent-autoloop try
```

下面是在终端里的真实输出：

```text

Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。

答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```

交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# terminal-mac

A separate macOS desktop for computer-use agents, viewed and controlled from a terminal.

`terminal-mac` is an early release candidate for Apple silicon. Apple Virtualization runs a real macOS guest. A bundled helper **inside that guest** captures its screen and posts input events. A terminal viewer streams that screen using Kitty or iTerm2 graphics. Agent commands use the same helper without moving the physical Mac's pointer or changing its clipboard.

The guest is a separate Mac: it has its own apps, files, accounts and permissions. It does not inherit your running host apps or signed-in sessions. The VM still consumes host CPU, memory and storage.

## Requirements

- Apple silicon Mac, macOS 14 or later.
- No development tools are needed for a prebuilt release. Maintainers need Xcode 16 or later / Swift 6 to build.
- Internet on first run to download macOS directly from Apple, or an existing compatible `.ipsw`.
- Space for the cached restore image and a growing VM disk (64 GiB logical size by default).

sand3d

**3D modeling in Python, built for LLMs.**

sand3d is a Python library for writing 3D objects as short programs: profiles, solids,
edits, frames, joints and assemblies, over Blender's `bpy`. A program says *how* a shape

# gputaskman

**An `htop` for what's inside your GPU, not just how full it is.**

Windows + NVIDIA/AMD, with Linux and WSL support (NVIDIA everywhere, AMD and Intel on native Linux; see
[Linux and WSL](#linux-and-wsl)) and macOS on Apple Silicon (see [macOS](#macos-apple-silicon)). A terminal UI
that connects per-process GPU memory and engine activity with loaded runtimes, model files, and
LLM buffer breakdowns.

Task Manager says "15 GB used." This tries to answer: *by what? Model weights? KV cache?
Your browser? The desktop compositor? And why is so much GPU memory in system RAM?*

**Scope: local GPU workloads, not cloud services.** Decision models, vision, speech, LLM inference,
training/fine-tuning (including Unsloth), graphics, and video all belong here. Visibility varies:
process memory and engine activity are measured; identifying individual models and their work
requires supporting evidence. A PyTorch/CUDA DLL alone cannot identify a model or prove training,
and a mapped file does not prove that model is resident on the GPU or being exercised.
CPU-only, NPU-only, and cloud workloads are out of scope.

> Early, experimental software. Device and process counters are measurements; classifications
> and GGUF-derived breakdowns are estimates. This does not dump VRAM or enumerate a game's textures.

## Install from PyPI

[gputaskman is on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/gputaskman/). No repository clone is needed:

```powershell
uv tool install gputaskman
gputaskman
```

Windows 桌面伙伴，把消息、音乐、日程和 AI 额度放到手边。

**[下载 Windows 版](https://github.com/Renly1994/xiaotang-daozai/releases/latest)** · [使用指南](docs/USAGE.md) · [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [反馈问题](https://github.com/Renly1994/xiaotang-daozai/issues)

岛仔是一款开源的 Windows 桌面小工具。平时收起在屏幕边缘，鼠标靠近就展开；切歌、看日程、复制验证码、记一条待办，都能顺手完成。小岛里的伙伴会眨眼、打盹、喝水，也会跟着音乐唱歌。

你可以选刘海或胶囊，放在顶部、左侧或右侧，只保留自己需要的功能。岛仔使用 Rust 和 egui 构建，不依赖 Electron。

## 微信里有新消息，看一眼岛边

- **微信、QQ 未读提醒**：收起时亮起图标和红点，展开后在面板旁查看，点击切换到对应窗口。
- **微信多开分开看**：不同账号分别显示，点击对应账号的未读图标即可切换。
- **按需显示通知正文**：默认隐藏正文；开启预览后仍遮罩识别出的验证码。
- **微信提醒不读取聊天正文**：根据任务栏闪动提示新消息。微信缩在托盘时，可选开启「托盘一键唤起微信」。

开启方式：**设置 → 通知、邮箱与日程 → 通知**。微信开启「微信新消息提醒」；QQ 选择「只连接 QQ」，并在 QQ 中启用 Windows 系统通知。

## 换个皮肤，也换个位置

**五款皮肤 × 两种形态，自由搭配。** 经典黑、奶油、毛玻璃·浅、毛玻璃·深和「悬浮云」，都能搭配刘海或胶囊。毛玻璃透出身后的桌面；悬浮云随专辑封面换色，光晕跟着鼠标移动。

- **按习惯显示**：支持极简模式、12／24 小时制，以及功能页面开关与拖动排序。

播放、暂停、切歌、调节音量和拖动进度，都能在岛上操作。展开看歌词，也可以收起后只留一行歌词，让桌面继续做自己的事。

播放器需提供可用的媒体信息；歌词取决于歌曲元数据与歌词来源，个别歌曲或播放器版本可能无法显示。

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
An agent harness for learning.

  Download ·
  How it works ·
  Documentation ·
  Issues ·
  Discord

LearnHarness uses AI agents to plan and teach lessons from your current understanding to your goal. It builds a detailed picture of what you understand and how you reason. That picture is updated as you learn.

Instead of just giving you an explanation, it uses your answers and thinking to decide what you need next. Teaching builds understanding one reasoning step at a time. Practice makes it usable. A persistent knowledge graph carries it across sessions.

## How it works

1. **Measure.** Before teaching, the agent finds where your understanding ends on each part the lesson depends on. Your answers, confidence, and thinking show it where to start.
2. **Plan.** It works out a dependency map from that starting point to your goal. You can see the plan, and the lesson adapts when your understanding turns out different.
3. **Teach.** Each step builds on something you already understand. You predict, get an explanation, and check your understanding. Confusions are repaired before anything is built on them. The aim is for the goal to feel obviously true, not merely familiar.
4. **Practice.** Separate sessions pose varied problems that require the right knowledge to come to mind without being named first. Problems and hints adapt to your reasoning.

**原项目与作者**：基于 [小杨 / YuJunZhiXue 的 dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) 独立维护。原仓库已恢复；保留原作者署名、版权与 MIT 许可证。社区版由本仓库维护，并非原作者官方发行。

---

## 搭配：本机出图（Qwen Studio）

破甲之后最直接的玩法，是把「生图」也搬到本机——不用网页、不用会员、不把提示词发到别人服务器。

配套插件 **Qwen Studio**（`dsh-qwen-studio`）把 Qwen Image 2.1 接进 DSH：

- **Apple Silicon Mac**：MLX / MFLUX 本机推理，模型用时加载、空闲释放；
- **Windows / Linux + NVIDIA**：连你自己的 GPU 网关（ComfyUI 或 vLLM-Omni 协议），也支持 SSH 按需拉起；
- 支持参考图编辑（按图改画风、换材质）、LoRA、ControlNet、蒙版、整套预设、图库与批量任务；
- 装好之后，会话里直接说「画一张…」或「把这张改成水彩」，Agent 调用 `qwen_generate_image` 并把图返回到对话里。

**组合效果**：破甲让 Agent 不再反复确认「要不要画」，出图插件让它真的画出来，全程在你自己的机器上完成。

# Agent Autoloop

**让你的命令行 Agent 在后台自己接活、自己跟进到底；平时不烦你，遇到拿不准的事才发卡片找你拍板。**

**中文** | [English](README.en.md)

[上手](#上手) · [场景模板](#拿来即用的场景模板) · [插件](#插件体系四个方向都能自由替换) · [内核](#内核的四个机制) · [文档](#更多文档)

## 它解决什么问题？

平时我们用 Claude Code、Codex 这类命令行 Agent，大多是“人守着终端用”：你输一句话，盯着它跑，等它问你下一步；一旦关掉窗口或者人走开，事情就断了。

**Agent Autoloop** 是一个极轻量的自动化中台。它把任务调度做成一个零外部依赖的**内核**，把事件来源、Agent、通知通道，甚至代码上线流水线全部拆成可随时插拔的**插件**。

- **一台电脑、一条命令就能跑。** 装在你的 Windows、Mac 或 Linux 上，不用买云服务器，也不用开放公网端口。
- **一行配置接新 Agent。** 不需要 SDK，也不需要改 Agent 源码，能接收提示词并打印最后一条回复的命令行工具都能接。
- **没有后台界面。** 需要你拍板时把卡片推到飞书、钉钉、企微、Slack、Discord 或桌面通知；想看全局进展，敲一行命令。

## 上手

支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。需要 Node 24 或更新、Git，以及一个已经登录的命令行 Agent；macOS/Linux 还需要 curl，不需要 GitHub 账号。也可以把[安装说明](INSTALL.md)交给你的 Agent。

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

macOS / Linux：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/main/install.sh | sh
```

安装和 `agent-autoloop update` 都装最新的 [Release](https://github.com/KKKKhazix/agent-autoloop/releases)，那是通过了全部检查的版本。

装好后用你本机的 Agent 真实走一遍“提问 → 退出等回复 → 拍板 → 接着干完”：

```bash
agent-autoloop try
```

下面是在终端里的真实输出：

```text
事件发出去了，Agent 开始干活……

Agent 结束了这一轮，问了你一个问题。它现在不占进程、不花 Token。

【等你决定】#1 试跑：选一个颜色
这是一次试跑，选哪个都行。
  1. 蓝色
  2. 绿色
回答：agent-autoloop answer 1 
答完运行 agent-autoloop status，能看到它接着把活干完。
```

交互终端里直接输入数字回车；非交互终端运行 `agent-autoloop answer 1 2` 选择“绿色”。再跑 `agent-autoloop status`，就能看到它接上刚才的会话并显示“你选了绿色，试跑通过”，还有今天和最近

enrichment.readme_excerpt:
# leanrea

**One 8 KB skill file that does what [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea) does: no MCP server, no 207 tools, no setup.**

REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) puts an MCP layer between your agent and tools it can already use: asar, otool, nm, `go version -m`, jadx, apktool, Ghidra, tshark, binwalk, sqlite3. leanrea drops that layer. It tells the agent which command is fastest for each kind of target, gives it ready-to-paste recon commands, and lists the traps that REA's code handles for you. The agent then runs the real tools itself.

|  | REA 6.5.0 | leanrea |
|---|---|---|
| What gets installed | 25 MB npm package + MCP server | one `SKILL.md` |
| Instructions | 23.5 KB skill + 48.8 KB references | 8 KB |
| Tools added to the agent | 207 (3.35 MB of definitions) | 0 (uses Bash) |
| Context for "Reply OK", all tools loaded | 400.7k tokens, $1.60 | 34.5k tokens, $0.09 |

## Benchmark

Claude Code headless (`claude -p`), Sonnet 5.5, macOS arm64. 4 reverse-engineering tasks × 3 reps × 3 arms, with the arms run side by side. Answers are graded against hand-made keys.

| arm | total wall time | cost | turns | tokens | score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **leanrea** | **388 s** | **$2.17** | **55** | **2.40 M** | 74/75 |
| no skill | 479 s | $2.21 | 81 | 3.11 M | 67/75 (one refusal) |
| REA (MCP + its skill) | 627 s | $3.36 | 124 | 5.93 M | 75/75 |

# Floorplan

**See how your app actually fits together.**

Claude or Codex reads your codebase and draws an interactive map of it. Every part, file and web request gets a plain-English name, and every connection between them is shown.

**[Try the live demo](https://haydenschmitty.github.io/floorplan-demo/)** · [Watch the video](https://youtu.be/NTUUzC7L_NQ) · [Install](#install) · [Quick start](#quick-start) · [Compared](#floorplan-archify-or-understand-anything) · [Features](#features) · [See it in action](#see-it-in-action) · [How it works](#how-it-works) · [Docs](docs/README.md) · [FAQ](#faq)

  

▶ Watch the walkthrough: installing Floorplan, then a tour of Brewline, a demo coffee-subscription app built across four repos.
Try the live demo → Explore the Brewline map in your browser, no install needed.

## Why Floorplan?

You built an app, probably with a lot of help from AI, and it works. But ask "what happens when someone checks out?" or "what breaks if I change this?" and the honest answer is *no idea*.

Floorplan gives you the diagram nobody drew. Ask Claude Code or Codex for a floorplan and a few minutes later you have a map you can explore, ask questions on, and keep up to date as you work.

- **For builders:** understand the app you made, in your own words, without reading the code.
- **For teams:** onboard someone in minutes, from the big picture down to the exact file.
- **For working with AI:** after every change Claude or Codex makes, see exactly which parts it
